body:
[gd_img name="clinic-front" alt="Goel Dental clinic entrance on Main Shivalik Road, Malviya Nagar" cap="Main clinic, Malviya Nagar"]

From one chair to a specialist team

Goel Dental began on 1 January 2011 as a single-chair clinic in Malviya Nagar. [gd_confirm]Old page says 2011; Google profile says 2010[/gd_confirm] It has since added specialists and digital equipment so that more treatment can be finished in fewer visits.

Where we are

  • Malviya Nagar (main clinic): Lower Ground, 14/185-186, Main Shivalik Road, New Delhi 110017. Directions
  • Kalkaji: CGHS-empanelled dental department at Irene Hospital. Branch details

[gd_confirm]Old page mentions a third branch in Kirti Nagar; confirm if active[/gd_confirm]

Who treats you

Treatment is planned by the specialist for the problem: an endodontist for root canals, an oral surgeon for extractions and surgery, orthodontists for braces and aligners, and a periodontist for gums. See our dentists.

Fewer visits

With on-site CAD/CAM, the clinic can make zirconia crowns, ceramic veneers, inlays and onlays in the same visit when the case allows. It also has an in-house OPG (full-mouth X-ray), digital RVG X-rays, a dental microscope and a Biolase soft-tissue laser. See technology.

3D-printed dentures and night guards, and digitally planned implant surgery, are also offered.

How we work

  • Fees are published: see fees. Your exact fee is given after the exam.
  • Extended hours are available on request.
  • Your rights and ours are set out in the patient charter; hygiene in the infection control policy.

Questions

When did Goel Dental open?

The clinic opened in Malviya Nagar in 2011 as a single-chair practice.

Who runs Goel Dental?

Dr Shikha Goel, an endodontist (MDS, Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics), is the clinic's director.

Can treatment be done in one visit?

Some can. Same-day crowns, veneers, inlays and onlays are made on site, and some root canals can be finished in one sitting. The dentist confirms after the exam.

title: Infection Control at Goel Dental

[gd_img name="steril" alt="Instrument sterilisation area at Goel Dental" cap="Sterilisation area"]

Why it matters

Infections such as hepatitis B and C, HIV and tuberculosis can spread through unsafe practice in any clinic. Each measure below reduces that risk.

What we do

  • Instruments: cleaned and sterilised between patients [gd_confirm]Add autoclave type and pouch/indicator system[/gd_confirm]
  • Surfaces: disinfected between patients

The clinic's NABH accreditation is listed on the home page. [gd_confirm]Confirm NABH certificate number and validity[/gd_confirm]

title: Patient Charter: Your Rights and Responsibilities
seo: Patient Charter: Rights & Responsibilities | Goel Dental
desc: What Goel Dental commits to: fee schedules, itemised bills, clear explanations, consent, second opinions and confidentiality, and what we ask of patients.
quick: Goel Dental's patient charter sets out what the dentist commits to (published fees, itemised bills, plain explanations, no treatment without your agreement), your rights as a patient, and what the clinic asks of you in return.
body:
What your dentist commits to

  • A schedule of fees, procedures and diagnostics, and an itemised bill on request
  • Telling you their qualifications for the proposed treatment
  • Keeping waiting time short and giving you undivided attention
  • Welcoming a friend or relative to join the discussion
  • Explaining diagnosis, prognosis and procedure in plain language
  • Not starting until you understand the benefits and risks of each option and have agreed, verbally or in writing

Your rights

  • Treatment regardless of status, age, gender, religion, caste, culture or political affiliation
  • To be heard fully without interruption
  • To refuse a prescription you cannot read
  • Emergency contact details for problems after treatment
  • Confidentiality and dignity during examination and treatment
  • Written details of prescriptions, procedures and treatment
  • The expected cost in advance, and an itemised bill
  • A second opinion, and to discuss and choose between options
  • To ask about the dentist's credentials and the clinic's infection control
  • To ask about applicable discounts

What we ask of you

  • Share your full medical and family history
  • Be on time; give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel
  • Keep realistic expectations and tell us if anything is unclear
  • Take part in your treatment and care for your oral health at home
  • Do not ask for inflated bills or false certificates
  • Pay the amount agreed in the treatment plan
  • If you are unhappy, talk to us

Questions

Can I get an itemised bill?

Yes. Ask at the front desk; it is part of the charter.

How much notice do I need to give to cancel?

At least 24 hours, so the slot can go to another patient.

title: Root Canal Treatment for Children
seo: Root Canal for Children (Pulpotomy) in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Why a child's infected tooth may need a root canal or pulpotomy, how it is done, and why a crown follows. Endodontist-led at Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: Save an infected milk or young permanent tooth
quick: A root canal in a child removes infection from a milk tooth or a young permanent tooth so it can stay in place. Children's teeth have different anatomy, so the procedure (often a pulpotomy) and the materials are different, and a prefabricated crown is usually fitted afterwards to stop the tooth breaking.
body:
Why save a child's tooth?

Each tooth holds space for the teeth around it. Losing one early can let others drift and cause crowding. In a young permanent tooth with deep decay, root canal treatment is often the only way to keep it.

Procedures

  • Indirect pulp treatment and direct pulp capping: protect the nerve when decay is close to it
  • Pulpotomy: removes the infected top part of the nerve
  • Root canal: cleans and seals the whole canal

The crown afterwards

Children get a prefabricated crown to protect the treated tooth. On a permanent tooth it is replaced with a cosmetic crown once the tooth reaches adult size.

Who does it

An endodontist or paediatric dentist. At Goel Dental, Dr Shikha Goel. For anxious children, laughing gas is available.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for kids' root canal and crown[/gd_confirm] EMI on leading credit cards.

Questions

Why treat a milk tooth that will fall out?

An infected milk tooth can harm the permanent tooth beneath it, and losing it early can cause crowding.

title: Fillings for Children
seo: Tooth Fillings for Children in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Fluoride-releasing fillings for children's cavities, including coloured fillings. Why filling milk teeth matters. Children's dentistry at Goel Dental.
card: Fluoride-releasing fillings, in colours if your child likes
quick: Children's fillings use materials that release fluoride, which helps stop decay from spreading. Filling a cavity keeps the milk tooth in place until the permanent tooth is ready; coloured fillings are available for children who want them.
body:
[gd_img name="kids" alt="Child in the children's dental room at Goel Dental" cap="Children's room"]

Why fill a milk tooth?

An untreated cavity can lead to early extraction and a space maintainer, spread decay to nearby teeth and affect the permanent tooth growing underneath.

The fillings

  • High-fluoride materials that help stop decay
  • Coloured, glittering fillings if your child wants them
  • Also used to seal deep pits and grooves

Fluoride balance

Too little fluoride raises the risk of cavities; too much can cause fluorosis (white patches). The dentist advises the right amount for your child. See fluoride application.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for kids' fillings[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does a child's filling need an injection?

Small fillings often do not. The dentist decides based on depth, and uses numbing gel first when an injection is needed.

title: Fluoride Application and Sealants for Children
seo: Fluoride Treatment & Sealants for Kids | Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar
desc: Fluoride gel applied in trays for 2–3 minutes helps harden children's enamel. Who it suits, how often, and pit and fissure sealants. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: 2–3 minute fluoride gel to strengthen enamel
quick: Fluoride application is a 2–3 minute treatment: fluoride gel or paste is held on the teeth in trays, stays on the surface for several hours and helps re-mineralise enamel. It adds to, but does not replace, brushing twice a day.
body:
Why it helps

Sticky foods, colas and chocolates stay on teeth and raise the risk of cavities. Rinsing and brushing after them helps; fluoride adds protection.

How it is done

  1. Teeth are cleaned.
  2. Fluoride gel or paste is placed in trays and held on the teeth for 2–3 minutes.
  3. Your child avoids eating and drinking for a short time afterwards, as advised.

Pit and fissure sealants

A thin coating seals the deep grooves of back teeth, where food collects and cavities often start.

Too much fluoride?

Excess fluoride can cause fluorosis (white patches). The dentist checks your child's fluoride sources before advising treatment.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for fluoride application and sealants[/gd_confirm]

Questions

How often should my child have fluoride applied?

Usually every 4–6 months, depending on cavity risk.

title: Laughing Gas (Nitrous Oxide) Sedation
seo: Laughing Gas Sedation Dentistry for Kids & Adults | Goel Dental
desc: Nitrous oxide (laughing gas) helps anxious children and adults relax for dental treatment. How it works, monitoring, who it suits. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: Relax in 2–3 minutes; wears off in minutes
quick: Laughing gas is nitrous oxide mixed with oxygen, breathed through a small nose hood. You stay awake and responsive but relaxed; the effect starts in about 2–3 minutes and clears within 3–5 minutes of stopping. Goel Dental uses it for anxious children and adults, and for strong gag reflexes.
body:
Who it suits

  • Children and adults who are anxious about dental treatment
  • Fear of needles, a strong gag reflex or very sensitive teeth
  • Longer procedures such as several fillings, root canals or extractions

How it works

  1. A nasal hood is placed over your nose; you breathe normally.
  2. The dentist adjusts the mix of gas and oxygen; most dental work needs about 30% nitrous oxide.
  3. Your oxygen level is monitored with a pulse oximeter throughout.
  4. When the gas stops, it clears from the body within about 3–5 minutes.

What to know

  • You stay awake and can respond; it is not general anaesthesia.
  • Local anaesthetic is still used to numb the tooth.
  • The level can be changed during treatment.

Dental surgery under deeper sedation or anaesthesia, including for children, is done at the Kalkaji branch in Irene Hospital. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm[/gd_confirm]

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for laughing-gas sedation[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Will my child be asleep?

No. Laughing gas relaxes your child while they stay awake and can respond.

Can I drive after laughing gas?

The effect wears off within minutes. The dentist checks you have recovered before you leave. [gd_confirm]Confirm clinic advice on driving[/gd_confirm]

title: Bone Grafting and Sinus Lift for Implants
seo: Bone Grafting & Sinus Lift for Implants in Delhi | Goel Dental
desc: When the jaw bone is too thin for an implant: bone grafting and sinus lift, assessed with a CT scan, done before or with implant surgery. Goel Dental.
card: Rebuild thin jaw bone so an implant can hold
who: Dr Shikha Goel with the oral surgeon
quick: An implant needs enough healthy bone. If the jaw has thinned after a long gap or gum disease, bone grafting adds bone at the site, and a sinus lift adds height in the upper back jaw below the sinus. Both are planned from a CT scan and done before or with implant surgery.
body:
[gd_img name="implant-model" alt="Dental implant model at Goel Dental" cap="Implant planning"]

When it is needed

  • A tooth has been missing for a long time and the bone has shrunk
  • Long-standing gum disease has caused bone loss
  • Low bone height under the sinus in the upper back jaw

How it is assessed

If the first exam suggests weak bone, a CT (CBCT) scan measures bone volume. Dr Shikha Goel and the oral surgeon then decide whether a graft is needed.

The procedures

  • Bone grafting: your own bone or a graft material is placed where bone is missing, for a small area or a larger defect.
  • Sinus lift: in the upper jaw, the sinus floor is raised and grafted to add height without perforating the sinus.

Grafting is usually done before the implant; sometimes in the same surgery.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for bone graft and sinus lift[/gd_confirm] CBCT scan: ₹2,500–4,500 on the 2026 fee list.

Questions

Does everyone need a bone graft for an implant?

No. Only when the scan shows too little bone to hold the implant.

title: Post and Core for Badly Damaged Teeth
seo: Dental Post and Core Treatment in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: A post and core rebuilds a root-canal-treated tooth that has lost over half its crown so it can hold a crown. Types, steps, 1–3 visits, aftercare. Goel Dental.
card: Rebuild a broken-down tooth to hold a crown
quick: A post and core rebuilds a root-canal-treated tooth that has lost a lot of structure. As a rule, if more than half of the visible tooth is gone, a thin post is fixed into the root and a core is built around it to support a crown. It takes one to three visits.
body:
[gd_img name="crown-steps" alt="Tooth rebuilt and crowned at Goel Dental" cap="Crown on a rebuilt tooth"]

When it is needed

After large decay, a fracture, a lost filling or root canal access, there may be too little tooth to hold a crown. Without support, the crown can come off.

What it is

  • Post: a thin rod of fibre or metal placed in the root. Only possible in a root-canal-treated tooth.
  • Core: filling material built around the post to replace lost tooth; it supports the crown or bridge.

Types of post

  • Prefabricated: fibre or metal, ready-made in different sizes
  • Custom cast: made in a lab from an impression of the root

Steps

  1. The post is cemented into the root.
  2. The core is built up.
  3. An impression or scan is taken for the crown.

Aftercare

Avoid biting very hard food directly on the tooth and avoid sticky food, which can loosen the crown.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for post and core[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does every root canal tooth need a post?

No. Only when too little tooth is left to hold a crown.

title: Crown Lengthening
seo: Crown Lengthening Surgery in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Crown lengthening exposes more tooth by reshaping gum or bone so a crown or filling can hold. Procedure, stitches, healing time and aftercare. Goel Dental.
card: Expose more tooth so a crown can hold
quick: Crown lengthening removes a little gum, bone or both to expose more of a tooth, so a crown or filling has enough to hold on to. It is done under local anaesthetic; stitches come out after 7–10 days, and the gum is usually left to heal for about three months before the final crown.
body:
When it is used

  • A tooth broken or decayed at the gum line
  • Too little tooth above the gum for a crown or filling
  • Cosmetically, to even out a gummy smile

The procedure

  1. Local anaesthetic numbs the area. Neighbouring teeth may be included so the gum line is reshaped evenly.
  2. The gum is gently moved back; some gum, and often a little bone, is removed. Sometimes this is done with a laser.
  3. The area is rinsed and stitched.

Aftercare

  • Ice on the face for the first few hours reduces swelling.
  • Soft diet; brush nearby teeth but avoid the gums. A pain reliever and mouth rinse are prescribed.
  • Stitches are removed after 7–10 days.
  • The gum heals for about three months before the final crown, so the crown edge does not show later.

Fee

[gd_confirm]Fee for crown lengthening[/gd_confirm] EMI on leading credit cards.

Questions

How long until I get my crown?

Usually about three months, once the gum has settled.

title: Chipped or Broken Tooth Repair
seo: Chipped or Broken Tooth Repair in Malviya Nagar | Goel Dental
desc: Chipped or broken tooth: what to do now, and repair options from one-visit bonding to veneers, crowns and root canal. Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar.
card: From one-visit bonding to crowns, by how much broke
quick: A chipped or broken tooth should be seen soon, before it breaks further or gets infected. Small chips are usually repaired with tooth-coloured bonding in one visit; larger breaks may need a veneer, a crown, or a root canal if the nerve is exposed.
body:
What to do now

  • Call the clinic: [gd_phone]
  • Take an over-the-counter painkiller if needed, following the label.
  • Cover a sharp edge with damp cotton or sugar-free gum.
  • Avoid biting on the tooth.
  • Do not try home repairs; they can make the damage worse.

Repair options

How much brokeUsual repairVisits
Small chipBonding: tooth-coloured resin, shaped and hardened with light1
Front tooth, moderate chipVeneer: thin porcelain or resin shellAbout 2
Large piece lostCrown; same-day CAD/CAM crown possible1–3
Nerve exposedRoot canal, often a post and core, then a crown2–3

Most broken teeth can be repaired without extraction. The dentist confirms after an exam and X-ray.

Questions

Is a chipped tooth an emergency?

See a dentist soon, especially if there is pain, sensitivity or a sharp edge. Severe pain, swelling or bleeding needs same-day care.

Can a chipped front tooth be fixed in one visit?

Small chips usually can, with bonding.
